action.name: edit_ir
action.note: bulk loop for the iterations in which every lane is active (cols >> 8 of them): 4 strided loads per wait using the 13-bit load offset, adds in the original order; the masked per-lane loop handles the rest behind a guard

notes.text: The strided per-lane loop waits on every load and recomputes the exit mask each iteration. For the cols>>8 iterations in which all lanes are active no mask is needed: 4 loads per wait via the 13-bit load offset (0, 1024, 2048, 3072), adds in the original order. 1.28x; at 3.7 TB/s this is close to the bandwidth seen in AXPY (4.7 TB/s).
